name: dinomem recall gate
description: Mid-session recall enforcement via before_tool_call (LANGUAGE-AGNOSTIC): blocks the first COLD fs/exec reach on a turn until a recall tool has run. No user-message parsing — fires on the danger (cold fs/exec) not the message, so it works regardless of the user's language. Complements the bootstrap-only dinomem-open-notes hook, which cannot cover mid-session recall. recallTools/fsTools are config-driven; neuron ships the full retrieval set (session_search/graph_search/docs_search/data_query on top of memory_search/memory_get).

enforce.description: Master switch. false = dry-run (never actually blocks).

agentFilter.description: Only gate sessions whose sessionKey includes this substring. Empty string = all agents (neuron default — installer-agnostic).

recallTools.description: Tools that count as 'recall done' for the current turn. Neuron set (memory_search/memory_get native + neuron's session_search/graph_search/docs_search/data_query). Does NOT include semantic_search, which is analyst-workspace-only. The blockReason lists exactly these, so it never names a tool the install lacks.

fsTools.description: fs/exec tools gated: first COLD use (no recall yet this turn) triggers one nudge.

cooldownTurns.description: Minimum turns between gate fires, to avoid nagging on repeated misses.
